newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Armed man holds three hostage in Naenae bank.
newsitem.headline: Armed man holds three hostage in Naenae bank.

text.p: A robber brandishing a gun was holding three people hostage in the Naenae branch of Trustbank, on Wednesday, Radio New Zealand reported.
Shots were heard about 10.30 a.m. and there were unconfirmed reports that a person had been injured.
Armed police had cordoned off the Hillary Court shopping area and an ambulance had moved into place.
An eyewitness told the radio station that two bank customers and a staff member are being held hostage. Another said a man was seen holding a gun to the head of the staff member.
RNZ said several members of the armed offenders squad entered the building a few moments ago.
The situation seemed to have calmed down a little but the cordon was still in place and it was not clear whether the armed man was still in the bank or not, RNZ said.
